ModMetaData.name: Stormproof
ModMetaData.author: AzraelGodKing
ModMetaData.description:
Defend your colony from the Rim's natural disasters: solar flares, lightning, surges, EMP, toxic fallout, heat and cold extremes, eclipses, flashstorms, droughts, and more.
GRID DEFENSE Solar shield (flares), storm spire (lightning harvest), storm capacitor bank, surge protector, EMP dampener, armored conduit, load shedder, and grid monitor.
ATMOSPHERE & WEATHER Weather forecaster, fallout scrubber (indoor detox), storm caller (summon rainy thunderstorms), static discharge pylon (capacitor-powered shocks).
HAZARD HARDENING (late-game research) Atmospheric barrier - suppress toxic fallout / toxic surge / ash / haze map-wide while powered. Climate stabilizer - cancel heat wave, cold snap, volcanic winter, heat dome, and polar front temperature offsets. Sky restorer - restore usable daylight during eclipses, volcanic winters, ash, and darkened skies. Fire suppressor - extinguish fires in a wide radius (flashstorm / dry lightning). Drought condenser - cancel drought plant-growth penalties (Odyssey).
EVENTS Ion storm, dry lightning front, heat dome, polar front, toxic surge - each with a matching Stormproof counter. Vanilla natural incidents (flares, fallout, flashstorms, heat/cold, eclipse, volcanic winter, drought) are also covered once hazard hardening is online.
STORM VANE Decorative copper weather vane. Looks great.
Requires the Harmony mod. RimWorld 1.6. Safe to add to existing saves; deconstruct all Stormproof buildings before removing.
